choreography.source: GOB 145 declares an instant interlock special. The shipped ILDB names move 277 DoubleOverheadSmash for the Karate exchange.
choreography.runtime: AbilityHandler verifies the live current opponent and queues the move. The ordinary interlock resolver uses CombatAnimations to play the Karate special on the bound opponent.
choreography.test: PR741 verifies the real stock Karate exchange with move 277, neutral hit 7 and +75 melee-resisted hit 5. The disposable Soldier replay exercises the same stock use in and out of interlock. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/741#issuecomment-7075743659

behavior-tests.source: GOB 145 stores a base 7 melee hit, two independent ten-second −10 modifiers and a ten-percent ten-second Enraged proc.
behavior-tests.runtime: The current-opponent queue binds the special to the live fight. The landed ability applies typed damage, independent accuracy and defence records, and its Enraged roll through the timed holder.
behavior-tests.test: OverhandSmashDamageTests pins the base and OperativeBatchThreeTests verifies success and miss draws around the ten-percent threshold, both independent stat consumers and timer expiry. PR618 verifies Enraged on a player. PR741 verifies disabled at rest, misses before a hit, the matching resistance comparison, both debuffs, 20 IS and 12 s reuse. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/741#issuecomment-7075743659
